files.description: One entry for every file under "The files to judge", keyed by its path, and for no other.

probes.description: Before the items: for an invariant, one entry per clause of its predicate and per edge of the boundary that clause draws, each a concrete input at that edge and what the text requires there, or the two things it could require. For an entity, the cases its docs decide, and each test they define tried on an input its candidate fields answer differently.

items.description: Every item of the checklist for the file's kind, keyed by the item's name, each answered.

ok.description: Whether the file meets this item.

evidence.description: One line: why. On a fail, the words at fault, one concrete input where it matters, and a one-line fix.

material.description: Only on a failing item whose defect is material: a concrete input inside the invariant's boundary on which two careful readings of its text require different outputs. Leave it out otherwise.

input.description: The concrete input (a line, a config, a context), inside the boundary.

reading_a.description: One reading of the words at fault.

output_a.description: The output (field values) the invariant requires under reading A.

output_b.description: The output it requires under reading B; different from output_a.
